title: Report opened from a tile covers exactly the tile's dates
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Technician Efficiency pill to Last Quarter.
  3. Open the pill again, write down the dates at the top of the calendar (e.g. Jul 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2026), then press Escape.
  4. Click the report icon beside Technician Efficiency.
  5. Read the report's Date control (e.g. Date: This month), then click it and read the dates it covers.
  6. Write down the report's total Efficiency figure.
  7. In the report's Date control click the same preset again (e.g. Last quarter).
  8. Read the dates and the total Efficiency figure again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The report covers exactly the dates you wrote down from the tile, first day and last day the same (e.g. Jul 1, 2026 to Sep 30, 2026).
  • Clicking the same preset in the report does not move the window: the dates and the total Efficiency figure are unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 10. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 03_Range_After (calendar header shows the dates) and 12_technician-efficiency_After, used for on-screen labels only.
